description.content: The `workspace` object represents an Astro Workspace, which is a collection of Deployments that can be accessed by a specific group of users. It contains metadata about a Workspace, but does not contain objects within the Workspace such as users and Deployments. Make requests to `workspace` endpoints to manage high level details about your Workspace. To manage resources within a Workspace, make requests to the endpoints related to those resources, such as `users`, and use the `workspaceIds` parameter to filter results by Workspace. See [Configure Workspaces](https://astronomer.io/docs/astro/manage-workspaces).
List Workspaces in an Organization
